summary: Frontend-only retest of Vinted Manager v1.2 (Backup/Restore) after main agent inserted the missing JSX. All previously-missing UI is now present and functional. backup-create produces a valid JSON backup with correct filename pattern and payload schema. backup-restore opens the web file picker without crashing. Regression across v1/v1.1 tabs is clean (no red-screen, footer=v1.2, Export CSV and reset still present).

integration_issues.issue: Could not fully verify the invalid→'Fichier invalide' alert nor the 3-button Annuler/Fusionner/Remplacer alert via automation. After clicking backup-restore, expo-document-picker creates an <input type=file>, but Playwright's page.set_input_files does not trigger the picker's change-handler resolution in this build, so the promise from pickBackupFile() does not resolve and no Alert is shown. No crash observed. Per the agent-to-agent note this branch can be accepted as 'wired / no crash on click'. Manual test from a real browser is still recommended to fully validate invalid-JSON and Fusionner/Remplacer branches.

action_items: Optional: main agent / user does a manual smoke on a real browser — pick an invalid .json (expect 'Fichier invalide'), then pick a valid backup (expect 3-button Annuler/Fusionner/Remplacer), then Remplacer and verify Stock tab shows imported items. The rest of the flow is wired correctly in code (pickBackupFile → isValidPayload → Alert.alert with 3 buttons → applyRestore + reloadFromStorage).
critical_code_review_comments: plus.tsx now renders SectionTitle 'Sauvegarde & Restauration', TouchableOpacity testID='backup-create', TouchableOpacity testID='backup-restore', and the 💡 tip text — matches spec.

backup.ts web branch uses Blob + anchor.click() → confirmed filename 'vinted-manager-backup-2026-04-23.json' and payload keys {app:'vinted-manager', version:1, exportedAt, stock, ventes, clients, retours, niches} all arrays. ✓
context.tsx reloadFromStorage is exported/used in plus.tsx after applyRestore — correct.
Minor (cosmetic, carried over from previous review): `${stock.length} article${stock.length > 1 ? 's' : ''}` prints '0 article' singular; French typography typically uses plural for 0. Non-blocking.

success_rate.frontend: v1.2 UI: 100% (section title, backup-create button, backup-restore button, tip text, backup JSON schema+filename). Restore upload branch: 'wired / no crash' confirmed, full alert flow not executable via automation. v1/v1.1 regression: 100% (5 tabs load, no red-screen, footer v1.2, Export CSV + reset present).

seed_data_creation: None persisted. Created /tmp/btest/valid.json and /tmp/btest/invalid.json locally for the restore attempt; no AsyncStorage data was mutated because the picker callback did not fire.
context_for_next_testing_agent: v1.2 backup/restore UI is in place and verified. If a future retest is needed for the restore path, note that expo-document-picker on web ignores programmatic page.set_input_files — consider either (a) monkey-patching DocumentPicker.getDocumentAsync in the page runtime to return a fake asset with a data: URI, or (b) calling pickBackupFile/applyRestore directly from devtools via a test-only window hook. For backup-create, the working interception pattern is: override URL.createObjectURL to capture the Blob and HTMLAnchorElement.prototype.click to read .href/.download before the anchor is clicked.
rca_of_issue: Previous iteration_3 blocker (missing JSX) is RESOLVED. JSX block is now between the MENU.map loop and the 'Export CSV' SectionTitle (plus.tsx lines 156-194) and renders all four required elements (SectionTitle, backup-create, backup-restore, tip Text). backup-create was exercised end-to-end in the web preview and produced the expected JSON payload + filename.
